```prolog
:- module(main, [main/0]).
:- set_prolog_flag(double_quotes, chars).

main :-
    read_line_to_string(user_input, Line1),
    ( Line1 == end_of_file -> true
    ; number_string(T, Line1),
      forall(between(1, T, _),
             ( read_line_to_string(user_input, S),
               ( S == end_of_file -> true
               ; check_string(S, Verdict),
                 atom_string(VerdictAtom, Verdict),
                 format("~s~n", [VerdictAtom])
               )
             ))
    ).

check_string(S, Verdict) :-
    string_chars(S, Chars),
    ( valid(Chars, 0) -> Verdict = "YES"
    ; Verdict = "NO"
    ).

valid([], 0).
valid(['('|T], B) :- B1 is B + 1, valid(T, B1).
valid([')'|T], B) :- B > 0, B1 is B - 1, valid(T, B1).
```
